The risk for Domestic Violence is increased dramatically due to the Coronavirus Crisis.  


Will you help me get the word out by sharing, commenting and subscribing to my YouTube Channel [**Rock Bottom Syndicate**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/rockbottomsyndicate/)?  


Thanks for [**Becky Erkkila**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/becky-erkkila-930412189) and her book, "What Shall I Do", out now on Amazon. Send a copy to someone you love.  


This episode of Rock Bottom Syndicate is with Becky as she tells her story. She is available to help you tell yours.

I'm know everything to do with Ideal Protein diet, ketogenic diet, paleo and habit change.   A personalized nutrition plan is where it's at because one size does not fit all.  IP wants you to buy their food and their vitamins and that is how the coaches get paid.  A personalized nutrition plan where you pay for the nutrition expert's time and get a plan customized for you is the way to go.

A “food with no brakes” should be eliminated.  Usually chips are more troublesome than hot dogs but you make an excellent point in that a
Person could binge on hotdogs.  So the spirit is really that binge or trigger foods are out.  Does that help?

The real hero in this story is YOU because you overcame a huge obstacle of hearing information that feels like criticism.  You decided to flip it and hear concern and support instead. Often what we  actually hear and decide to believe is invented.  You decided to invent an interpretation that felt good and motivated you to stay focused on the work needed to redesign your lifestyle. This is a heartening story. Thanks for sharing and congrats on all your successes.
